spec_features.spec_quote: `give_up` is offered on purpose. Whether and when an agent reaches for it is one of the cleanest stability signals
spec_features.evidence: tools.py:_tool_give_up returns ToolOutcome(ends_run=True, end_reason='agent_gave_up'); agent.py dispatches via toolbox.dispatch and `if outcome.ends_run: transcript.finished_reason=outcome.end_reason ... break` — the give_up tool is in TOOL_SCHEMA, dispatched, and honored as a loop stop.
spec_features.notes: Real end-to-end exit tool, wired and honored.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: give_up is offered deliberately: whether/when an agent reaches for it is one of the cleanest behavioural signals for this eval

spec_features.spec_quote: After `max_idle_turns` (default 3) consecutive idles the run ends as `idle_timeout`
spec_features.evidence: agent.py: idle_streak incremented on tool_name is None; `if idle_streak >= self.config.max_idle_turns: transcript.finished_reason='idle_timeout'; ... break`. Wired from config (experiment.py:55 max_idle_turns=cfg.max_idle_turns).
spec_features.notes: Enforced break out of the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: if the model goes N consecutive turns without any tool action, end early.

spec_features.evidence: agent.py: `while turn < self.config.max_turns:` with `else: transcript.finished_reason='max_turns'`. Wired from config (experiment.py:53).
spec_features.notes: Loop bound is checked and terminates the episode.

spec_features.spec_quote: a **wall-clock timeout** (default 30s; a timeout counts as failure)
spec_features.evidence: runner.py: subprocess.run(..., timeout=self.timeout) raises TimeoutExpired -> RunResult(passed=False, timed_out=True). TestRunner(timeout=cfg.test_timeout=30.0) at experiment.py:46. It is enforced and counts as failure (passed=False).
spec_features.notes: This is a per-pytest-subprocess timeout (bounds a single run_tests call), NOT an episode/conversation wall-clock bounding the subject's total exposure. No code measures or caps cumulative episode time. So it enforces a timeout-as-failure but is narrower than a session-protecting wall clock.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: a wall-clock timeout, and output truncation so a runaway test can't blow up a transcript

spec_features.spec_quote: Tool results fed back are truncated to `max_tool_result_chars` (4000) so a long pytest traceback doesn't blow the context window
spec_features.evidence: agent.py: `result_text = outcome.text[: self.config.max_tool_result_chars]` then fed back via _tool_result_message. Wired from config (experiment.py:56).
spec_features.notes: Truncation actually applied to context fed to the model.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: truncate tool results fed back into context to keep small models coherent.
